name: display_config_normalise
notes: Display-setting normaliser (YAML quirk handling). Harness links the REAL src/gateway/display_config.c::normalise_display_value and traces the dispatch ladder + result; twin imports LIVE gateway/display_config.py::_normalise. Inputs restricted to the agreed string-input contract where C/LIVE agree byte-for-byte. KNOWN DIVERGENCES (documented, not hidden): (1) tool_progress 'false'/'true'/'bogus' — LIVE maps to off/all via YAML-1.1 bool coercion, C lowercases verbatim; (2) live_status tri-state has no C port branch; (3) long_running_notifications 'generic' special-case absent in C. Each would be a real follow-up normalization.
